summary: Ready as a daily: a casual player finds 8 of 10, mostly Disney parks, with Universal Studios Japan at #3 and Chimelong Ocean Kingdom as the surprise. The old fixes are in; a few small leftovers can wait for the next rebuild.
reasons: Casual found Magic Kingdom, Disneyland, Epcot, Universal Studios Japan (via 'universal studios'), Tokyo Disneyland, Disneyland Paris, Hollywood Studios and Shanghai Disneyland; lives went on Animal Kingdom #15, Islands of Adventure #14, Cedar Point and Busch Gardens Tampa Bay, each showing a 2024 figure. Fan: 10/10 in 13 guesses for 3 lives, all on Orlando parks.

Good curve (Disney gimmes, Shanghai, DisneySea and USJ with thought, Chimelong as the stretch), but eight of ten are Disney and the natural next guesses (Animal Kingdom, Universal Orlando) all cost a life, so it can feel samey and lives go fast.

Old fixes checked: 'disney' now offers the four Disney top-10 parks, 'disneyland shanghai', 'disneyland hong kong', 'mgm studios', 'universal studios orlando' and 'ocean kingdom' resolve, Downtown Disney, African dodger, Wizarding World and the junk Epcot, Tokyo and Disneyland aliases are gone, and the regional parks show figures. The source stops at 2024 and the prompt says so.
fixes: Three non-park category members still get past the skip list because their category titles carry a qualifier: 'Golden Pass (Disney)', 'Pleasure Island (Walt Disney World)', '20th Century Fox World (Dubai)' (each costs a life if typed). Put those exact titles in the theme-parks skip list in scripts/topics.ts. If build.ts line 530 is changed to test cleanName(title) instead, drop 'Adventureland' from the skip list first: its members are Adventureland (Iowa) and Adventureland (New York), real parks that should stay.

'universal orlando' and 'universal hollywood' put Universal Studios Japan in the box (the 'Universal' alias plus trailing words), and once USJ is found they answer 'already found (#3 Universal Studios Japan)'. Add to the theme-parks groups in scripts/intent.ts: 'Universal Orlando' shared by Universal Studios Florida and Universal Islands of Adventure, 'Universal Hollywood' for Universal Studios Hollywood. Also 'Ocean Park' for Ocean Park Hong Kong (now 'not an answer for this list').
The source ranks Disney Adventure World and Everland 'T20' (both 5,598,000); the build shows Everland as #21. A miss on Everland should read #20 (tied).
